text.en: Pet parents routinely praise the doctor and veterinary technicians for their warm hospitality and attentiveness. Reviewers note that clinical staff take time to explain diagnosis details and answer questions thoroughly. Clients repeatedly describe the atmosphere as welcoming, emphasising that both long-standing pet owners and newcomers receive attentive support.

Clients specifically value the clinic's readiness and competence in handling exotic companion species, including pet rats and birds alongside dogs. Reviewers appreciate that veterinary assistants handle small and nervous animals with calm gentleness. Pet owners frequently note that their animals appear relaxed and secure during clinical examinations and treatment.

Pet owners report successful health resolutions for acute issues such as respiratory infections, supported by prompt dispensing of necessary medications. Reviewers also highlight quality routine procedures, including careful nail trims and thorough wellness assessments. Clients express strong confidence in the clinic's therapeutic and preventative recommendations.

q.en: Does Broadway Oaks Animal Hospital treat birds and exotic pets?

a.en: Yes, reviews and practice details confirm dedicated medical care for avian patients, pet rats, and other small exotic companion animals.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate same-day urgent appointments?

a.en: Clients report being accommodated within hours of calling when pets presented with respiratory infections or sudden symptoms.
Yes, the practice operates an on-site veterinary pharmacy, enabling clients to collect prescribed treatments directly after their visit.

q.en: How do clients describe the treatment costs?

a.en: Reviewers note reasonable and manageable fees for both exotic animal visits and canine wellness services.
